title: 국민연금만으로 충분할까 — 개혁 9.5%·추납·반납·임의가입·연금세금

source_audit.limitations: Private original 730 Korean auto SRT cues raw SHA and indexes verified; public full YouTube transcript English auto-translated, cannot claim exact Korean text matching. 33 speaker-source anchors and two independent law clarifications marked not spoken. Source audio and video frames not independently inspected. Specific lecturer claims 180-country pension outcomes and Samsung Q1 57tn won remain unproven without original authoritative statistics.
source_audit.evidence_reference: Original ZIP CRC PASS sha 69be8639162f8e00bfa09f0d4b8a6fe95db0a07054ad370709ce0d4e53628b5f; video#88 Korean 730 original cues 56318 raw bytes SHA 918e93eff069a7132e643a8d8a1bad0686f36c6ddd9e00e0e8c2408741e5e67b normalized 9748 Korean chars SHA 03ec0e604c6d3f9e162e33249fffc2997ca1c02053502ef7c6f5256c4c3e575c.

core_message: NPS reform 2026 premium rate 9.5% escalating to 13% by2033 and state duty to sustain benefits; actuarial payouts do not guarantee fixed future individual amounts. 노령연금 requires >=10 years, 1969+ standard age65, CPI adjustment and survivor pension tiers. Postponed contributions and repayment of prior lump sums differ; voluntary membership for nonworking spouse (about96,230 monthly in 2026 Apr) can fill eligible years. Private annuity 1500 cutoff and option to separate tax are nuanced.
